tasks.title: Tracker repository layer
tasks.description: Create TrackerRepository with getProjects, getIssues, getIssue, createIssue, updateIssue, searchIssues. Uses Phase 2 API client. Returns typed DTOs with pagination support.
acceptanceCriteria: All 6 methods exist with typed parameters and return types
Pagination returns { items, nextCursor, hasMore } shape
Returns typed error when API returns 404 for a deleted project

tasks.title: Tracker TanStack Query hooks
tasks.description: Query hooks: useProjects, useIssues (infinite), useIssue, useSearchIssues. Mutation hooks: useCreateIssue, useUpdateIssue. Stale-while-revalidate 30s. Mutations invalidate affected queries.
acceptanceCriteria: useIssues returns { data, fetchNextPage, hasNextPage, isLoading, error, refetch }
useCreateIssue().mutate(draft) invalidates the project issue list query key
useIssue returns disabled query when issueId is undefined

tasks.title: Tracker Zustand store
tasks.description: Create useTrackerStore: selectedProjectId, issueFilters, issueSort, viewMode, issueDraft. Persist filter preferences to AsyncStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: setFilter('priority', [High]) updates issueFilters.priority
Closing and reopening the app preserves last-used filter/sort
clearDraft resets all draft fields to defaults

tasks.title: Tab navigator with all tabs + Tracker route group
tasks.description: REPLACE the placeholder (app)/_layout.tsx created by auth phase (TASK-108) with full tab layout using bottom tabs. Add all 4 tabs: Tracker (active), Chat, Inbox, Settings. Each tab points to its route group. Chat/Inbox/Settings use placeholder screens for now. Create tracker/ route group with Stack navigator. Tab shell reads badge counts from useChatStore.unreadTotal and useInboxStore.unreadTotal Zustand stores when they exist (optional chaining or default 0). When chat/inbox phases create those stores, badges automatically appear.
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom tab bar shows all 4 tabs: Tracker, Chat, Inbox, Settings
Tab bar uses Huly design tokens: bg-surface inactive, text-primary active
Tab bar remains visible when navigating within the tracker stack
Tab shell reads badge counts from useChatStore and useInboxStore Zustand stores when they exist (defaults to 0 when stores not yet created)

tasks.title: Project list screen
tasks.description: Project list using useProjects. ProjectCard with identifier badge, name, issue count. Pull-to-refresh. Loading skeleton. Empty state.
acceptanceCriteria: Projects render with identifier, name, and member count
Pull-to-refresh triggers re-fetch and shows indicator
Empty state shows No projects message when API returns empty array

tasks.title: Issue list screen
tasks.description: Issue list at tracker/project/[id]. FlashList with infinite scroll. Filter bottom sheet. Sort controls. IssueRow with priority icon, identifier, title, status, assignee. Kanban toggle.
acceptanceCriteria: Scrolling past last page triggers fetchNextPage with footer spinner
Applying a priority filter immediately filters the displayed list
Switching to kanban view groups issues by status in horizontal scroll

tasks.title: Issue detail screen
tasks.description: Full issue detail at tracker/issue/[id]. All fields: title, description, status, priority, assignee, component, milestone, sub-issues, time tracking, comments. Bottom sheet pickers. Pull-to-refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: All issue fields render: title, description, status, priority, assignee, component, milestone
Tapping status chip opens bottom sheet; selecting calls useUpdateIssue
Deleted issue shows error state with back action instead of crashing

tasks.title: Create issue screen
tasks.description: Modal create screen. Zustand draft persistence. Form: title, description, status, priority, assignee, component, milestone, estimation. Validation. Cancel confirmation if dirty.
acceptanceCriteria: Empty title shows inline validation error; submit button disabled
Navigating away and back preserves draft via Zustand persist
After creation, issue list query is invalidated and new issue appears

tasks.title: Issue search
tasks.description: Search screen with debounced input (300ms). useSearchIssues hook. Reuses IssueRow. Recent searches persisted in AsyncStorage. Empty state.
acceptanceCriteria: Under 2 characters shows hint; 2+ triggers API after 300ms debounce
Tapping result navigates to issue detail
Recent searches persist across app restarts and can be cleared

tasks.title: UI primitives for Tracker
tasks.description: PriorityIcon, StatusChip, AvatarCircle. Props-only, no data fetching, max 80 lines each. Accessible labels.
acceptanceCriteria: PriorityIcon renders red urgent icon with accessibilityLabel
AvatarCircle shows initials with deterministic color when no image
All three accept testID prop
